Methods

Method notes describe process. Authoritative scientific status is generated only from structural claim records in the evidence ledger.

Truth-table and XAG backend

verified_main

The exact backend evaluates completed truth tables, emits deterministic XAGs, and counts reachable XOR-plus-AND gates with free negation.

Insights

  • Accuracy eligibility precedes reachable gate count.
  • Exhaustive replay binds the emitted XAG to its completed table.

Optimization

  • Canonicalize and eliminate unreachable gates before scoring.
  • Retain deterministic table, circuit, and artifact serialization.

Stop rules

  • Stop on any training inconsistency, table/circuit mismatch, nondeterminism, or non-improving gate count.

Evidence

  • Canonical truth-table implementation
  • Challenge-native XAG implementation

Arithmetic controls

verified_main

Constructive arithmetic circuits reproduce the four disclosed v1 controls.

Insights

  • The four v1 functions are disclosed controls, not blind-learning targets.
  • Their gate counts are constructive upper bounds.

Optimization

  • Use the controls to guard semantics and serialization while optimizing new methods on permitted synthetic or visible-only data.

Stop rules

  • Never use a disclosed function label or control recovery as evidence for a blind candidate.

Evidence

  • Arithmetic control constructors
  • Arithmetic control tests

Complemented ROBDD

verified_main

A shared complemented ROBDD represents multiple outputs and feeds deterministic XAG extraction.

Insights

  • Complemented edges and shared output roots reduce representation without changing exact semantics.

Optimization

  • Search variable orders under the final reachable-XAG score, not raw BDD nodes alone.

Stop rules

  • Reject any complemented-edge invariant violation or exhaustive replay mismatch.

Evidence

  • Complemented ROBDD implementation
  • ROBDD invariant tests

Care-BDD

verified_main

Care-BDD learns deterministic completions from permitted visible rows and emits exact XAG artifacts.

Insights

  • Visible-row completion and variable-order search must remain fold-local during selection.
  • Fairer scheduling fixed coverage but did not improve the frozen synthetic score.

Optimization

  • Prefer hypotheses that can improve exact-row completion rather than gate-only tuning at zero exact-row CV.
  • Use the frozen five folds, reuse-sibling policy, and 32-evaluation budget for the public gate.

Stop rules

  • Reject on visible training inconsistency, exhaustive inequivalence, budget drift, or loss to both frozen baselines.

Evidence

  • Care-BDD implementation
  • Care-BDD tests

Bounded SAT resynthesis

verified_main

Bounded SAT searches for smaller exact local XAG windows and preserves censored solver outcomes.

Insights

  • UNSAT proves only the exact frozen local encoding and bound.
  • Timeout and Unknown remain censored observations.

Optimization

  • Apply six-input local rewrites only to an already exact candidate.
  • Require whole-XAG equivalence after reinsertion.

Stop rules

  • Stop after two successive Timeout or Unknown outcomes, any inequivalence, or no strict gate reduction.

Evidence

  • Bounded SAT implementation
  • Bounded SAT tests

OxiDD oracle

verified_main

OxiDD provides a reduced independent oracle around the Rust production path.

Insights

  • An independent reduced oracle can catch ordering and semantic drift without becoming the production learner.

Optimization

  • Use only for reduced checks and finalist order comparisons.

Stop rules

  • Never use OxiDD as the production learner or challenge gate metric.

Evidence

  • OxiDD oracle adapter
  • OxiDD oracle tests

Bounded experiment runner

verified_main

The runner enforces the five-minute process-group cap and publishes truthful terminal evidence.

Insights

  • Only SUCCESS is runner success; VERIFIER_NOT_RUN can preserve candidate artifacts without claiming an official pass.
  • Failed and timed-out cells are evidence, not missing rows.

Optimization

  • Keep each algorithm cell under 300 seconds including startup and cleanup.
  • Bind source, tree, run spec, artifacts, logs, timing, memory, and terminal state.

Stop rules

  • Reject missing, malformed, overwritten, or source-unbound evidence.

Evidence

  • Bounded experiment runner
  • Runner adversarial tests

Official Julia wrapper

verified_main

The wrapper validates the exact official output contract before emitting a pass summary.

Insights

  • Official verification is a distinct authority from internal exhaustive equivalence.
  • Wrapper availability does not itself verify a candidate.

Optimization

  • Create immutable records only inside the authorized custodian boundary and bind every verifier input.

Stop rules

  • Fail on malformed output, metric mismatch, extra output, unsafe paths, file replacement, or nonzero Julia exit.

Evidence

  • Fail-closed Julia wrapper
  • Julia wrapper adversarial tests

ProjectedSupportBDD

verified_branch_only

ProjectedSupportBDD chooses fold-local per-output supports before exact shared-forest synthesis.

Insights

  • Per-output projected supports changed exact-row synthetic generalization where global-order tuning had not.
  • The final bound pair reproduced 104857/104857 exact rows and 72 gates.

Optimization

  • Use R2 as the leading input to a separate public-candidate integration review.
  • Preserve executable self-binding and fold-local support selection.

Stop rules

  • Reject any source/executable mismatch, support conflict, fold leakage, nondeterminism, or exhaustive inequivalence.

Evidence

  • ProjectedSupportBDD R2 branch log: 8f6eda40e089a12faa8df3827207024afd719865 at LOG.md

Tensor-network pilot

verified_branch_only

The pilot binds a deterministic local tensor pipeline to canonical Rust artifact generation.

Insights

  • A tensor model becomes comparable only after full prediction enumeration and the same Rust XAG backend.
  • The final pair proved pipeline repeatability on a fully observed parity fixture.

Optimization

  • Evaluate a future candidate only on permitted visible inputs and preserve the Rust authority boundary.

Stop rules

  • Reject device drift, unbound executable bytes, stream overflow, incomplete enumeration, or Rust equivalence failure.

Evidence
